verses.text: Wine mocks and beer picks fights. Anyone they lead astray is missing wisdom.
A king's terror is like a lion's roar. Make him angry and you risk your life.
It's honorable to stay clear of conflict. Every fool is ready to argue.
A slacker won't plow in winter. When harvest comes, they'll beg and have nothing.
Advice in a person's heart is like deep water. Someone with understanding can draw it out.
Plenty of people claim their love never fails. Who can find someone who actually stays faithful?
People who do right walk with integrity. Their children are blessed after them.
When a king sits on his throne to judge, his eyes sift out all evil.
Who can say, “I've made my heart pure. I'm clean and free of sin”?
The LORD detests dishonest weights and dishonest measures alike.
Even children show who they are by what they do, whether their actions are pure and right.
An ear that hears and an eye that sees, the LORD made both.
Don't love sleep or you'll end up poor. Open your eyes and you'll have enough bread.
“It's no good. It's no good,” says the buyer. Then they walk away and brag about the deal.
There's gold and there are plenty of rubies, but words that carry knowledge are a rare jewel.
Take the coat of someone who guarantees a stranger's debt. Hold it as security if they pledge for a wayward woman.
Food gained by fraud tastes sweet at first. Afterward your mouth is full of gravel.
Good advice makes plans firm. Get wise guidance before you go to war.
A gossip goes around spilling secrets. Stay away from people who can't keep their mouths shut.
Anyone who curses their father or mother will have their lamp put out in pitch darkness.
An inheritance grabbed too soon won't be blessed in the end.
Don't say, “I'll pay back that wrong.” Wait for the LORD, and he'll save you.
The LORD hates dishonest weights. Rigged scales don't please him.
A person's steps come from the LORD. How, then, can anyone understand their own path?
It's a trap to dedicate something in a rush and only think about what you promised afterward.
A wise king sifts out the wicked and drives the threshing wheel over them.
The human spirit is the LORD's lamp, searching deep inside a person.
Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. Love holds up his throne.
Strength is the glory of young men. Gray hair is the splendor of old men.
Blows that wound can cleanse away evil. Beatings purge the deepest parts of a person.
